component: Thunderbird Microsoft Graph enum extraction and generated importance representation

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The enum landing splits supported objects from enums and generates a concrete Importance enum for low, normal and high. The original Message accessor parses a JSON string into that enum and the setter stores its displayed string, replacing the old object wrapper and string member. Generated variants use camelCase serde/display names. Later accepted Message fields expose Option<Importance> and no longer use that accessor or EnumString. Extraction-test equality does not establish wire round trips or an unknown-value fallback.
title: Graph enum generation replaces the importance object wrapper with wire strings
